developer_reply: Hi Thorbjørn, we’re sorry for the bugs and frustrating experience, especially as a Premium user. Thanks for the honest feedback. Please contact us at contact@habitify.me so we can help, and share ideas at feedback.habitify.me.

text: I tried the app today because it looks promising, many features. But there seems to be problems in basic features. Say I want to limit coffee per day to 2 cups. With other apps I get a + and - button to indicate how many cups I had that day. With Habitify I have to long press, get to a menu, enter the number, hit 'Save'. This is super bad.
author: Kristoffer Nielsen
developer_reply: Hi Kristoffer, thanks for your feedback. We're sorry the coffee tracking is cumbersome. We appreciate your input and are working on improvements. Please email us at contact@habitify.me or share suggestions at feedback.habitify.me.
